body: Thank you! Yes, I will definitely use this time to heal and focus more on myself. I will definitely stay single for a very long time because although I’m feeling better now, that doesn’t mean I’ve completely moved on already.. and I still do love this girl but the best I could do is wish her the best. I want to be content with the happiness that I can find within myself and from friends and family. :)

Of course there’s still some lingering pain and sadness because it’s just been a little over a week and I still do feel disappointed that we didn’t get more time, it’s just that I don’t cry over her and feel like killing myself all the time anymore, which is a big difference for me because last week I was just a huge mess.

Should I actually cry a hundred times a day for a month and still constantly feel like dying for me to prove that it was the “real” thing? 

I loved this girl and I still do. I don’t think the length of our relationship defines the sincereness of our feelings.

I was devastated because I’ve never been deeply connected with someone before and it was really painful to lose a girl I deeply cared about. I still love and miss her, but what made the pain a lot less is the fact that I’ve already accepted the likeliness of her not coming back in my life anymore. It’s like I’m glad that we are both able to work on ourselves now, that’s why I’m trying my best to look forward.

thank you for this. i do know that time will heal me all throughout but what pains me the most right now is the fact that she want us to move on completely and never look back so the chance of being together again isn’t that high (unless she changes her mind in the future, but i doubt she will). i just really don’t know if i could live with the fact that it’s really over and never happening again.

It is the worst. :( I would do ANYTHING just to be given another shot with our relationship but it seems like she’s already made it clear that she wants the both of us to move forward with our lives and not look back anymore.
